image_description: A close-up shot of a white toilet paper roll mounted on a metallic, curved holder against a beige wall. The surface of the toilet paper is covered in black, handwritten-style text that appears to be gibberish or a stylized script, resembling an ancient inscription or code.

artifact_observations.location: Surface of the toilet paper roll
artifact_observations.reasoning: The presence of coherent-looking but semantically nonsensical black text/scripts on the toilet paper is a hallmark AI generation artifact. Real toilet paper does not feature such inscriptions. The text warps slightly with the curvature but maintains an unnatural sharpness against the soft paper texture.
The black ink/text appears to float slightly above the embossed texture rather than being absorbed into the fibers or printed flatly, creating a subtle layering inconsistency.
